about.title: About Me
about.description: I’m Hilal Najem — a backend-focused full-stack engineer specializing in Laravel architecture, scalable business systems, API-driven platforms, and deployment infrastructure. My work focuses on building maintainable applications with structured backend logic, operational reliability, responsive frontend systems, and long-term scalability. Beyond development, I engineer systems with performance, SEO structure, and business workflow precision in mind — creating platforms businesses can depend on operationally, not just visually.
about.quote: “I don’t build websites. I build structured digital systems that businesses can rely on long-term.”
